title: China Steel and Chung Hung Steel Raise December Prices for Third Straight Month; Mill Margins Seen Widening in Tandem
dek: China Steel and Chung Hung Steel have raised December prices for a third straight month, with mill margins seen widening, BigGo Finance reports.
summary: According to BigGo Finance's headline, China Steel and Chung Hung Steel have raised their December prices for the third consecutive month, and mill margins are expected to widen in tandem. The publisher's excerpt does not give the size of the increases or the products affected.
keyFacts: China Steel and Chung Hung Steel raised December prices
This is the third straight month of increases
whyItMatters: China Steel's monthly price settings are often treated as a bellwether for regional flat steel sentiment, so a third successive rise may signal firming conditions.
implications: Downstream buyers could face higher costs, while competing regional mills may take the increases as room to lift their own offers; the magnitude cannot be judged from the material.
